meta.note: Back lens of the Insta360 dual-fisheye rig. Intrinsics come from back_fisheye_calibration.json (checkerboard, 2026-08-20, rms 0.367 px). The extrinsic is NOT from an independent LiDAR-camera registration: it is T_lidar_front (ouster_0_1_registered/calib.json) composed with the rigid front->back lens transform of the dual-fisheye rig, i.e. a 180 deg rotation about the camera Y axis plus a 94.3 mm baseline along the optical axis. The 180 deg flip and the baseline were verified/refined against the registration_0820_* bags by maximising LiDAR depth-edge / image-edge alignment on /camera_back (refinement over the exact flip: rx=+0.01 deg, ry=-0.65 deg, rz=+0.79 deg, baseline=0.0943 m); the refined value also improves alignment on held-out bags. Re-run the vlcal pipeline on /camera_back for a fully independent calibration.
